response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced, versatile senior engineer with genuine geospatial credentials (GISCollective, Green Map web GIS, FOSS4G talk) and some high-throughput backend work in D at Sociomantic handling millions of requests per second, which shows low-latency and systems thinking. However, the core requirement — modern C++ (or Rust) in commercial/open-source settings — is only weakly met: his C/C++ exposure is a ~7-month stint at National Instruments in 2014-2015 and a university thesis, with the last decade dominated by TypeScript/Node.js and D. There is no evidence of routing/navigation data pipelines, tiling, real-time traffic integration, or large-scale distributed-system operations (consistency, fault tolerance, service discovery). He could plausibly ramp up given his demonstrated appetite for new stacks, but he would start well behind candidates with current C++ and navigation-domain depth.
strengths: Real geospatial/GIS product experience, including an open-source map data platform
Low-latency, high-throughput backend work (async I/O, fibers, caching) at ad-tech scale
Strong engineering discipline: TDD, CI/CD, test tooling authorship, broad polyglot adaptability
concerns: Modern C++ experience is minimal and over a decade old; no Rust at all
No routing/tiling, navigation guidance, or map-data pipeline experience
Recent roles are web/full-stack TypeScript, not systems or distributed infrastructure
